entries.topic: [CHECK GUN] gating: needs the second REFUSE, and shows even if the gun was left upstairs
originals: Prompt missing from the note: [CHECK GUN] / WORRIED / EXPLAIN / AGREE?
[CHECK GUN] is shown whenever Kara started with the gun?

entries.answer: CHECK GUN is how FORGOT GUN is revealed, so it is offered when the gun was left upstairs; it appears only after Kara refuses to sit twice. The benchmark gets the forgotten-gun part right but offers [CHECK GUN] even when Kara sat at once.

This will cause Ralph to stop Alice, and Kara will have the option to Check Gun'); PowerPyx 'Forgot Gun: … choose the Check Gun option to realize you didn't pick it up'; PowerPyx comments M83 2018-06-26 ('you have to refuse to sit … If you just decide to sit, you won't be able to unlock the node') and Cee 2020-01-09 ('I just had to choose to refuse to sit down twice'); template lock is rank 2 but its extra conjunct contradicts the FORGOT GUN node
entries.fix: K09q5 option 0 ([CHECK GUN]) requires: {"ch13HadGun": true} → {"ch13HadGun": true, "ch13Meal.ralphThreatenedAlice": true} (the flag K09q4 REFUSE already sets); update the adaptationNote sentence 'The wiki's claim that the button needs two refusals … is not built'.
